title: Luigi’s mansion esque hotel
content: This hotel has many tiers One of the main attractions is indoor pools in some of their main attractions Followed by some quest/game show type things you have to accomplish to move throughout the hotel/mansion There’s a brothel on one of the tiers At least for me, I had to join this brothel and save a young boy and girl both orphans, siblings. There is always a sense of war/apocalyptic. I have so many stories from this messed up realm I’ve fought many wars here Reach out to me for any questions or comments
